text:
Priya Khatri: Quick sync — we're planning an SDK compatibility change that touches auth headers + telemetry payloads. This will affect marketplace listings and SI integrations. Proposing: 8-week announced deprecation, 4-week shim/grace window, and telemetry gating for canaries. Need partner-comms timeline and who owns partner rollouts.

Alex Chen: sounds reasonable. question: do we require partners to update client auth header to `Authorization: Redwood v2 <token>` or accept both for the grace window?

Priya Khatri: We accept both during the grace window. After grace ends we only accept v2. Plan is to ship an SDK shim that maps v1->v2 for partners who can't update immediately.

Jordan Lee: +1 on shim. Also recommend a feature flag on the server side to flip enforcement per partner org — helps staged rollouts for large SIs.

Samir Patel: From infra: telemetry contract change is more painful. We need a version header in telemetry events so downstream partner analytics don't break. Suggest event header `X-RW-Telemetry-Version: 2`.

Alex Chen: if we're adding `X-RW-Telemetry-Version: 2`, call out the example in docs and SDKs. tiny sample for partners:```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Redwood v2 ABC" -H "X-RW-Telemetry-Version: 2" \
  -d '{"event":"call","model":"redwood-1","latency_ms":123}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/telemetry
```

Priya Khatri: Lia, can you run the partner comms plan? Need marketplace banner text, API changelog, and a partner webinar. Also which partners need special hand-holding?

Lia Gomez: I can. Priority list: 1) AWS/GCP marketplace sellers with integrated billing, 2) 3rd-party SI bundles (two large ones), 3) hardware partners with on-prem packages. I’ll schedule partner office hours and a joint runbook.

Jordan Lee: On the prod side: propose canary window for 2 weeks (small set of partners), then 2-week wider canary, then full enforcement. We'll gate via the server-side feature flag per partner.

Samir Patel: Note: key rotation and telemetry key validation must be coordinated with Dedicated/Private customers — they may be on older agent versions. We'll add a compatibility matrix in the ticket.

Priya Khatri: Timeline proposal: Week 0 announce; Week 2 SDK beta + shim release; Weeks 3-4 partner canaries; Week 6 broader canary; Week 12 enforcement. Lia — can you confirm partner availability for a webinar in Week 1?

Lia Gomez: Yep, aiming for Week 1 webinar (Wed). Will ping partner PMs and add a signup sheet.

partner-bot: @channel New JIRA created: PARTNER-9932 "SDK auth v2 + telemetry v2: partner rollout plan" — link: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/PARTNER-9932

Alex Chen: I'll own the SDK release notes and the shim repo. Will post PRs to the SDKs repo and a migration guide draft later today.

Priya Khatri: Perfect. Action items: Lia — comms & webinar, Alex — SDK + migration docs, Jordan — feature-flag rollout runbook, Samir — telemetry compatibility matrix, Priya — partner exec outreach. Add any other blockers now. :thumbsup:
